example.title: Monarch Beach Resort (opened as the St. Regis Monarch Beach), 1 Monarch Beach Resort

brief: A 2001 Tuscan/Mediterranean-revival resort on a terraced hillside: cream stucco wings of four and five storeys wrapped round a formal courtyard, red clay-tile hip roofs, an arcaded ground-floor loggia with round arches, per-room balconies with white balustrades and iron rails, and a grand double stair with a tiled fountain descending from the lobby terrace to a long lawn axis ending in columned pergola rotundas and the pool deck. Palms and clipped hedges everywhere. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
